source_text: By the late 1930s, following the 1936 Anglo-Egyptian Treaty, efforts intensified under figures like Elaine Hills-Young, who banned all circumcision by trained midwives in 1937 and emphasized the practice's unhygienic and damaging effects through education. [9]
